description: Enables player afterimage effects. The character’s frames are stored in a history buffer, and are displayed after a delay as afterimages.
name: AfterImage

description: Changes the duration of the player’s afterimage effects, if currently enabled. If no afterimage effects are being displayed, this controller does nothing. Known bugs: If the timegap parameter in the originating AfterImage controller is not set at 1, using this AfterImageTime will cause the frame positions to be reset.
name: AfterImageTime

description: Same as PalFX, except that this affects the palette of the background and lifebars as well as the palette of all characters and explods (regardless of the ownpal parameter). See the PalFX section for details on the parameters to AllPalFX.
name: AllPalFX

description: Adds to the drawing rotation angle used by AngleDraw.
name: AngleAdd

description: Draws the player (for 1 frame) rotated about his axis by the angle set by the AngleSet controller. When facing right, a positive angle means a counterclockwise rotation.
name: AngleDraw

description: Multiplies the drawing rotation angle used by AngleDraw by the specified factor.
name: AngleMul

description: Sets the drawing rotation angle used by AngleDraw. The angle is initialized at 0.
name: AngleSet

description: This is the same as DisplayToClipboard, except that message text is added on a new line, instead of overwriting whatever text is already on the clipboard. See DisplayToClipboard for a format description.
name: AppendToClipboard

description: This controller allows (de)activating the player’s analog vectors without input from a joystick. Values will be clamped to [-1,1] with the exception of analog triggers which are normalized to [0,1].
name: AssertAnalogVector

params.name: leftx
params.placeholder: vector (float) Sets the LeftX analog vector. Defaults to 0.

params.name: lefty
params.placeholder: vector (float) Sets the LeftY analog vector. Defaults to 0.

params.name: rightx
params.placeholder: vector (float) Sets the RightX analog vector. Defaults to 0.

params.name: righty
params.placeholder: vector (float) Sets the RightY analog vector. Defaults to 0.

params.name: lefttrigger
params.placeholder: vector (float) Sets the LeftTrigger analog vector. Defaults to 0.

params.name: righttrigger
params.placeholder: vector (float) Sets the RightTrigger analog vector. Defaults to 0.

description: This controller allows (de)activating the player’s commands without any button presses. If the player has multiple commands with the same name, the controller will affect all of them.
name: AssertCommand

description: This controller allows you to assert up to three input flags simultaneously via single sctrl. Similarly to AssertSpecial, there is no limit how many times this controller is called. Each flag will be automatically “de-asserted” at every game tick, so you must assert a flag for each tick that you want it to be active. Ikemen interprets input flags the same was as if corresponding input keys were pressed.
name: AssertInput

description: This controller allows you to assert up to three special flags simultaneously. MUGEN will automatically deassert each flag at every game tick, so you must assert a flag for each tick that you want it to be active.
name: AssertSpecial

description: Changes the value of the guard.dist parameter for the player’s current HitDef. The guard.dist is the x-distance from P1 in which P2 will go into a guard state if P2 is holding the direction away from P1. The effect of guard.dist only takes effect when P1 has movetype = A.
name: AttackDist

description: Sets the player’s attack multiplier. All damage the player gives is scaled by this amount.
name: AttackMulSet

description: Same as PalFX, except that this affects the palette of the background and lifebars instead of the palette of the character. See the PalFX section for details on the parameters to BGPalFX.
name: BGPalFX

description: If the player is a helper, binds the player to a specified position relative to its parent. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing.
name: BindToParent

description: If the player is a helper, binds the player to a specified position relative to its root. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing.
name: BindToRoot

description: Binds the player to a specified position relative to the specified target.
name: BindToTarget

description: This SCTRL is still experimental and subject to possible changes, there is no guarantee this will be supported as is in future IKEMEN Go versions.
name: Camera

description: Changes the action number of the player’s animation.
name: ChangeAnim

description: Like ChangeAnim, except this controller should be used if you have placed P2 in a custom state via a hit and wish to change P2’s animation to one specified in P1’s air file. For example, when making throws, use this to change P2 to a being-thrown animation.
name: ChangeAnim2

description: Selects which movelist assigned in the character’s DEF file should be displayed in the Pause menu command list.
name: ChangeMovelist

description: Changes the state number of the player.
name: ChangeState

description: Erases any text currently on the player’s clipboard.
name: ClearClipboard

description: Sets the player’s control flag.
name: CtrlSet

description: Sets the player’s defense multiplier. All damage the player takes is scaled by this amount.
name: DefenceMulSet

description: Temporarily changes the depth size of the player’s for 1 frame. Similar to Width in function.
name: Depth

description: If called by a helper-type character, DestroySelf causes that character to be removed from the field of play. DestroySelf is not valid for non-helper characters.
name: DestroySelf

description: Assigns dialogue data to be displayed either right before the lifebar calls the fight during first round (last frame of RoundState = 1) or at the last active frame of the final round (RoundState = 4, right before screen starts fading out). If more than 1 player calls this sctrl, who will end up initiating dialogue is chosen randomly.
name: Dialogue

description: Unlike Mugen, Ikemen GO can use unlimited amount of numeric arguments. Also it supports format specifiers, e.g. %0.2f (prints float value truncated to 2 digits), %v (prints the value in a default format and optimal formatting, regardless if it’s int, float or string).
name: DisplayToClipboard

params.name: params
params.placeholder: exp_1, exp_2, exp_3, exp_4, exp_5, exp_6

description: Adds the specified amount to the player’s dizzy points.
name: DizzyPointsAdd

description: Sets the amount of dizzy points that the player has.
name: DizzyPointsSet

description: Sets the player’s Dizzy flag. For the duration that this flag is set, combo hit counter does not reset and the combo count lifebar text will stay on screen.
name: DizzySet

description: Turns the whole screen a solid color, excepting foreground-layer animations like hit sparks and ontop explods. Foreground layers of the stage will not be visible.
name: EnvColor

description: Causes the screen to shake vertically.
name: EnvShake

description: The Explod controller is a flexible tool for displaying animations such as sparks, dust and other visual effects. Its functionality includes that of GameMakeAnim, which is now deprecated.
name: Explod

description: Changes the position binding time of the player’s explods.
name: ExplodBindTime

params.name: value
params.placeholder: binding_time may be used instead of time = binding_time.

description: Shakes the screen using the fall.envshake parameters set by an attack (see HitDef controller). This controller is effective only if GetHitVar(fall.envshake.time) is not zero, and it sets GetHitVar(fall.envshake.time) to zero after being executed. This controller is used in common1.cns to shake the screen when a player falls, and is not normally useful otherwise.
name: FallEnvShake

description: Creates force feedback for supported force feedback devices. This controller is not implemented in MUGEN 1.0. Parameters to the ForceFeedback controller may not be specified using arithmetic expressions. It is an exception in this regard.
name: ForceFeedback

description: Creates a game animation, like a hit spark or a super charging effect. This controller has been superseded by Explod and is now considered deprecated. Support for it may be removed in future versions.
name: GameMakeAnim

description: Changes a player’s GetHitVar directly, without requiring a hit.
name: GetHitVarSet

description: Accelerates the player downwards, using the value of the player’s yaccel constant.
name: Gravity

description: Applies a temporary offset to the player’s ground level, which is otherwise 0. This makes the player treat a different position as pos y = 0, and therefore allows coding features such as platforms.
name: GroundLevelOffset

description: Sets the player’s Guard Break flag.
name: GuardBreakSet

description: Adds the specified amount to the player’s guard points.
name: GuardPointsAdd

description: Sets the amount of guard points that the player has.
name: GuardPointsSet

description: Temporarily changes the vertical size of the player’s “push box” for 1 frame. Similar to Width in function: the values are added to the height, as defined in the player’s constants file—they do not override them. A positive value will make the box larger, and a negative one will make it smaller.
name: Height

description: Creates another instance of the player as a helper character.
name: Helper

description: Adds to the current combo counter.
name: HitAdd

description: Temporarily specifies the types of hits that are be allowed hit to the player.
name: HitBy

description: Defines a single hit of the player’s attack. If the player’s Clsn1 box (red) comes in contact with his opponent’s Clsn2 box (blue), and the HitDef was define on or before that particular point in time, then the specified effect will be applied. This is one of the more complex, but most commonly-used controllers. A single HitDef is valid only for a single hit. To make a move hit several times, you must trigger more than one HitDef during the attack.
name: HitDef

description: When the player has been hit and is in a falling state, apply damage from the fall (specified in the hitdef) to the player.
name: HitFallDamage

description: When the player has been hit, sets the player’s fall variables.
name: HitFallSet

description: If the player has been hit and is in a falling state, sets the player’s velocities to the fall velocities (fall.xvel and fall.yvel) specified in the HitDef.
name: HitFallVel

description: Defines a hit override. If the player is hit by an attack of the specified type, he will go to the specified state number instead of his default gethit behavior. Up to 8 hit overrides can be active at one time.
name: HitOverride

description: This controller is deprecated.
name: HitVelSet

description: Adds the specified amount to the player’s life, scaled by the player’s defense multiplier if necessary.
name: LifeAdd

description: Displays text/sprites/anims synchronized with each other, using lifebar data. The intended use case is implementation of messages, often found in commercial fighting games.
name: LifebarAction

description: Sets the player’s life to the specified value.
name: LifeSet

description: Loads the specified data and overrides the data of the execution character. Note that all the data before reading will disappear.
name: LoadFile

params.name: savedata
params.placeholder: var_type (string) Specifies the data type that should be read. Valid values for var_type are “var”, “fvar”, and “map”.

params.name: path
params.placeholder: “save_path” (string) Specifies the path of the file to be read (relative to the character folder). An error occurs if you make a mistake in the path.

params.name: maps
params.placeholder: map_1, map_2, map_3… (string) A list of maps to load. Defaults to empty.

params.name: maps.include
params.placeholder: filter (string) All maps containing this string in their names will be loaded. Defaults to empty.

description: This controller is deprecated; use the Explod controller.
name: MakeDust

description: Adds value to player’s map.
name: MapAdd

params.name: map
params.placeholder: “map_name” (string) Specifies a name of the map that we add value to.

params.name: value
params.placeholder: expr (int or float) expr is the value to add to the map.

description: Clears all of the player’s maps, except those containing the specified strings. Maps that are defined in the character’s DEF file will be reset to the value specified there.
name: MapReset

params.name: exclude
params.placeholder: “exception_string“ (string) If a map’s name contains this string, it won’t be cleared.

params.name: exclude2
params.placeholder: “exception_string“ (string) Extra filter parameters. Up to exclude8.

description: Sets value to player’s map. This state controller can be used to change a number that has already been set via character’s DEF file or to set a new map.
name: MapSet

description: Reset the round or match and resume. By default (when no optional parameters are set) has the same effect as F4 debug key (round restart). Optionally allows characters and stage reloading, which also changes the state controller functionality to work like shift+F4 debug key (match restart).
name: MatchRestart

description: Modifies the parameters of an existing stage background controller.
name: ModifyBGCtrl

description: Modifies the parameters of an existing 3D stage background controller.
name: ModifyBGCtrl3D

description: Modifies currently playing music.
name: ModifyBgm

description: Modifies the parameters of an existing Explod. Syntax is basically the same as Explod. However, this controller is subject to future change. Any code relying on this controller is not guaranteed to work in the future.
name: ModifyExplod

description: Using this state controller will update the specified parameters of the player’s currently active HitDef. Has no effect if no HitDef is active.
name: ModifyHitDef

description: Allows changing some player parameters that are otherwise out of reach, or don’t justify having their own dedicated state controllers. Some parameters should be used with care.
name: ModifyPlayer

description: Using this state controller will update the specified parameters for the projectiles with the specified ID. Syntax is essentially the same as for Projectile.
name: ModifyProjectile

description: This state controller allows modifying parameters of a char’s Reflection
name: ModifyReflection

description: Using this state controller will update the specified parameters of the player’s currently active ReversalDef. Has no effect if no ReversalDef is active.
name: ModifyReversalDef

description: This state controller allows modifying parameters of a char’s Shadow
name: ModifyShadow

description: Modifies the following sound parameters on-the-fly. This cannot modify the lowpriority parameter. If you need your sound to be low priority, call PlaySnd with the respective parameter set.
name: ModifySnd

description: This state controller allows modifying the stage’s BG elements. Refer to stage documentation for more information.
name: ModifyStageBG

description: This SCTRL lets a character modify basic stage parameters or “stage vars”, as declared in the stage .def file. Not all parameters are modifable for now, but the SCTRL could be expanded in the future to allow it.
name: ModifyStageVar

description: Using this state controller will update the specified parameters for the texts with the specified ID. Syntax is essentially the same as for Text sctrl.
name: ModifyText

description: Resets the movehit flag to 0. That is, after executing MoveHitReset, the triggers MoveContact, MoveGuarded, and MoveHit will all return 0.
name: MoveHitReset

description: Temporarily specifies types of hits that are not allowed to hit the player.
name: NotHitBy

description: Does nothing. May be used for disabling other state controllers by changing their type to Null.
name: Null

description: Changes the player’s display offset. The player is drawn shifted from his axis by this amount.
name: Offset

description: This state controller allows you to directly modify a player’s collision boxes without changing their animation.
name: OverrideClsn

description: Applies temporary effects the player’s palette. These will also affect the palette of any explods and helpers the player owns, unless they have set ownpal to a nonzero value.
name: PalFX

description: If the player is a helper, adds value to parent’s map. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing. Parent refers to the instance that spawned the helper.
name: ParentMapAdd

description: If the player is a helper, sets value to parent’s map. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing. Parent refers to the instance that spawned the helper.
name: ParentMapSet

description: If the player is a helper, adds to one of the player’s parent’s working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be added to by this controller. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing.
name: ParentVarAdd

description: If the player is a helper, sets one of the parent’s working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be set by this controller. Does nothing if the player is not a helper.
name: ParentVarSet

description: Pauses the game for the specified amount of time. Player and background updates are not carried out during this time.
name: Pause

description: Plays back a music. Supported file formats: mp3, ogg, wav.
name: PlayBgm

description: Disables the player’s push checking for one tick. Push checking keeps players from overlapping one another. By temporarily disabling push checking, dodge-type moves in which the player passes through another (but can still be hit) can be implemented.
name: PlayerPush

description: Plays back a sound.
name: PlaySnd

description: Offsets the player’s position by the specified amounts. The X coordinate is relative to the player’s axis, with positive values moving in the direction that the player is facing. The Y coordinate is relative to the player’s axis, with negative values moving up.
name: PosAdd

description: Temporarily freezes the player’s position.
name: PosFreeze

description: Sets the player’s position to the specified coordinates. The X coordinate is relative to the center of the screen, with positive values moving right. The Y coordinate is relative to the floor, with negative values moving up.
name: PosSet

description: Adds the specified amount to the player’s power.
name: PowerAdd

description: Sets the amount of power that the player has.
name: PowerSet

description: This controller is only useful for debugging. PrintToConsole prints a specified message to debug mode console, as well as terminal / command line window, if it’s opened.
name: PrintToConsole

description: Creates a projectile for the player. The Projectile controller takes all the parameters of the HitDef controller, which control the HitDef for the projectile. In addition, Projectile has the following additional parameters:
name: Projectile

description: Adds the specified amount to the player’s red life, scaled by the player’s defense multiplier if necessary.
name: RedLifeAdd

description: Sets the amount of red life that the player has.
name: RedLifeSet

description: Changes one of the player’s palettes to another.
name: RemapPal

description: Remaps one sprite with another (or does this for multiple sprites at once, based on character’s CNS RemapPreset data)
name: RemapSprite

description: Removes all of a player’s explods, or just the explods with a specified ID number.
name: RemoveExplod

description: Removes all of a player’s texts, or just the texts with a specified ID number.
name: RemoveText

description: Defines a reversal. If one of P2’s Clns1 boxes comes in contact with one of P1’s Clsn1 boxes and a ReversalDef is active, then P1 will reverse P2’s attack. Use with p1stateno (and optionally p2stateno) for creating reversal attacks.
name: ReversalDef

description: If the player is a helper, adds value to root’s map. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing. Root refers to the main player.
name: RootMapAdd

description: If the player is a helper, sets value root’s map. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing. Root refers to the main player.
name: RootMapSet

description: If the player is a helper, adds value to root’s working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be added by this controller. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing. Root refers to the main player.
name: RootVarAdd

description: If the player is a helper, sets value root’s working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be set by this controller. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing. Root refers to the main player.
name: RootVarSet

description: Add specified amount of ticks into round time.
name: RoundTimeAdd

description: Set round time to specified amount of ticks.
name: RoundTimeSet

description: Put specified data together and save it as binary. It uses gob, which is a serialized format for Go language, as the storage format. All characters specified by the character or helper who executed the function are stored at that time.
name: SaveFile

description: Adds the specified amount of points to P1 current score counter.
name: ScoreAdd

description: Specifies whether or not the player’s movement should be constrained to the screen or not. Also determines whether the camera should move to follow the player or not. The results of this controller are valid for 1 tick.
name: ScreenBound

description: Like ChangeState, except that this changes a player back to a state in his own state data. Use this when you have placed an opponent player in a custom state via an attack, and wish to restore the opponent to his own states.
name: SelfState

description: Allows temporarily changing the function of the player’s keys. Resets every frame.
name: ShiftInput

description: Changes the panning of a currently playing sound. This controller may be continually triggered to smoothly move a sound across the sound field or to have a sound follow the player.
name: SndPan

description: Changes the player’s sprite priority. Higher-priority sprites are drawn on top of lower-priority sprites.
name: SprPriority

description: Changes the current state type and move type. Useful for states that go from the ground into the air, etc.
name: StateTypeSet

description: Stops any sound which is playing on the specified channel.
name: StopSnd

description: Freezes the gameplay and darkens the screen. While each player is frozen, no time passes for them. Use for a dramatic pause during the start of hyper attacks.
name: SuperPause

description: Makes the P1 and/or the specified partner exit Standby state. If no parameters are given it affects the player that called it. (Also affects helpers)
name: TagIn

description: Makes the the player and/or the specified partner enter Standby state. If no parameters are given it affects the player that called it. The main purpose of the Standby flag is to put a player away so it won’t interfere in a Tag match. For that reason it carries several special properties:
name: TagOut

description: Adds the player with the specified ID to the original player’s target list. Do not confuse this player ID with a target ID. Target ID can be assigned with chainID parameter of GetHitVarSet.
name: TargetAdd

description: Binds the player’s specified targets to a specified location relative to the player’s axis.
name: TargetBind

description: Adds the specified amount to all targets’ dizzy points.
name: TargetDizzyPointsAdd

description: Drops all targets from the player’s target list, except possibly for those having a specified target ID number. Useful for applying effects to only certain targets.
name: TargetDrop

description: Turns all targets to face a specified direction relative to the player.
name: TargetFacing

description: Adds the specified amount to all targets’ guard points.
name: TargetGuardPointsAdd

description: Adds the specified amount to all targets’ life, scaled by the targets’ defense multipliers if necessary.
name: TargetLifeAdd

description: Adds the specified amount to all targets’ power.
name: TargetPowerAdd

description: Adds the specified amount to all targets’ red life, scaled by the targets’ defense multipliers if necessary.
name: TargetRedLifeAdd

description: Adds the specified amount of points to targets’ current score counter.
name: TargetScoreAdd

description: Makes all targets change to the specified state number.
name: TargetState

description: Adds the specified amounts to all targets’ velocities. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the target is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.
name: TargetVelAdd

description: Sets all targets’ velocities to the specified values. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the player is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.
name: TargetVelSet

description: Adds value to all team members maps.
name: TeamMapAdd

description: Sets value to all team members maps.
name: TeamMapSet

description: Text controller is used for displaying text on screen.
name: Text

description: Overrides the player’s animation transparency parameters for current game tick. Useful for special effects.
name: Trans

description: Changes the geometry or certain properties of the player’s collision boxes.
name: TransformClsn

description: Apply certain deformations to the char’s sprite.
name: TransformSprite

description: Instantly turns the player to face the opposite direction. Does not play a turning animation.
name: Turn

description: Adds to one of the player’s working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be added to by this controller.
name: VarAdd

description: Sets the specified int variable to a random value. Float variables cannot be set by this controller.
name: VarRandom

description: Sets a contiguous range of the player’s working variables to the same value. Either float variables or int variables can be set by this controller, but not both at the same time.
name: VarRangeSet

description: Sets one of the player’s working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be set by this controller, but not both at the same time.
name: VarSet

description: Adds the specified amounts to the player’s velocity. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the player is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.
name: VelAdd

description: Multiplies the player’s velocity by the specified amounts. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the player is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.
name: VelMul

description: Sets the player’s velocity to the specified values. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the player is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.
name: VelSet

description: Selects a victory quote from the player to display in the next victory screen.
name: VictoryQuote

description: Temporarily changes the size of the player’s width bar for 1 tick. Useful for controlling the pushing behavior when the player makes contact with another or with the sides of the screen.
name: Width

description: Zoom was a beta feature in Mugen 1.1. It is a fully functional state controller in Ikemen GO.
name: Zoom
